_comment: Expectation manifest for lane-config's frozen acceptance-checks.
Enforced repo-wide by scripts/evals-all.mjs on every push and PR.
expect "green" = a past fix that must not regress. MUST exit 0.
expect "red"   = a known-failing check (open concern). MUST exit 0 or 1.
A check file missing from this manifest FAILS the gate.
LOCKED (evals/**): improvement loops may never edit this file.

mutations.why: init naming a model it could not know puts a harness assignment nobody chose into every new repo — the drift the config exists to stop, now wearing a helpful default
without the gate_profile guard a config validates clean and then dies at the one step that cannot be skipped — gate-guard.sh refuses every push, PR and merge for a lane with no code_gate
mutations.find:
problems+=("lanes.gate_profile is empty — no work can leave this repo without a gate, so this is not optional. Set it: $0 set-lanes --gate-profile

")

mutations.why: without the base_branch guard validate blesses a config whose every worktree is cut from an unset ref, which fails at spawn with the same message a missing --cwd produces
mutations.find: [[ "$(jq -r '.lanes.base_branch // ""' "$CFG")" != "" ]] || problems+=("lanes.base_branch is empty — every worktree is cut from it, so start refuses without it")

mutations.why: blessing a config with zero profiles lets a run start with nothing declared, so every lane falls back to whatever the spawn command happened to say
mutations.find: (( n > 0 )) || problems+=("no profiles declared — every spawn will be denied")

mutations.why: accepting a profile with no model means the harness default silently becomes the decision — the drift that started this work
mutations.find: [[ -n "$MODEL" ]] || die "set-profile needs --model. An unnamed model is the harness default, not a decision."

mutations.why: an empty setup.baseline passing validate leaves every lane unable to distinguish its own red from an inherited one, which cost the 2026-08 run several cycles
mutations.find: [[ "$(jq -r '.setup.baseline // ""' "$CFG")" != "" ]] || problems+=("setup.baseline is empty — a lane cannot tell a real red from an inherited one")

mutations.why: turning the name-branch refusal into an accept means a profile whose agent does not exist in the harness's own registry stores clean and dies at spawn — the exact issue-#88 failure, reported by herdr as an indistinguishable cold-pane timeout

flipping 'registry undeterminable' from accept to refuse means a repo with no claude on PATH (or opencode's list unparseable) refuses every claude/opencode profile outright, which is a false refusal worse than the spawn failure this check exists to catch

init shipping the bare plugin file name as the agent id hands every new repo a config its own validate refuses — claude resolves a plugin subagent only as <plugin>:<file>, so `lirbox-planner` is in no registry anywhere
